FIRST_SHARE_REMINDER.subject: Your Seenly profile is waiting for its first responses
FIRST_SHARE_REMINDER.preheader: Share your profile link with friends to begin your analysis.
FIRST_SHARE_REMINDER.title: Your Profile is Ready, Time to Share
FIRST_SHARE_REMINDER.body: You created your Seenly profile, but have not received enough evaluations yet. Share your link to discover what your friends genuinely think of you.
FIRST_SHARE_REMINDER.footer: This email was sent regarding your Seenly account.
FIRST_SHARE_REMINDER.plainText:
Hello,

Your Seenly profile is ready! Share your link to discover honest feedback from your friends:
{{shareUrl}}

The Seenly Team

NEW_EVALUATION.subject: {{count}} new evaluations received on Seenly
NEW_EVALUATION.preheader: Your friends have answered your questions.
NEW_EVALUATION.title: New Evaluations Recorded
NEW_EVALUATION.body: {{count}} new anonymous evaluations have been submitted for your Seenly profile. Visit your dashboard to explore the updated insights.
NEW_EVALUATION.footer: You are receiving this because evaluation notifications are enabled.
NEW_EVALUATION.plainText:
Hello,

{{count}} new anonymous evaluations were received for your Seenly profile!
Check your results at:
{{dashboardUrl}}

The Seenly Team

REPORT_UNLOCKED.subject: Congratulations! Your Outside Report is Unlocked
REPORT_UNLOCKED.preheader: You reached 3 evaluations and your report is ready.
REPORT_UNLOCKED.title: Your Report is Now Available
REPORT_UNLOCKED.body: Great news! 3 friends have evaluated your profile. Your outside perception analysis and gap pattern are now unlocked.
REPORT_UNLOCKED.plainText:
Hello,

Great news! 3 friends have evaluated your profile and your outside report is now unlocked.
Explore your report at:
{{dashboardUrl}}

The Seenly Team

INACTIVITY_REMINDER.subject: Catch up on your Seenly profile
INACTIVITY_REMINDER.preheader: Keep your profile active and collect fresh perspectives.
INACTIVITY_REMINDER.title: We Miss You
INACTIVITY_REMINDER.body: It has been a while since your profile had recent activity. Share your link again to gather up-to-date perspectives from your network.
INACTIVITY_REMINDER.footer: You can change your notification preferences anytime.
INACTIVITY_REMINDER.plainText:
Hello,

It has been a while since your profile had recent activity. Share your link again to gather up-to-date perspectives:
{{dashboardUrl}}

The Seenly Team

CAPACITY_80_PERCENT.subject: You've reached 80% of your response capacity
CAPACITY_80_PERCENT.preheader: You are approaching your response limit.
CAPACITY_80_PERCENT.title: Capacity Notice (80%)
CAPACITY_80_PERCENT.body: Your Seenly profile has reached 80% of its response capacity ({{currentResponses}}/{{maxCapacity}}). Expand your capacity to avoid missing further feedback.
CAPACITY_80_PERCENT.plainText:
Hello,

Your Seenly profile reached 80% capacity ({{currentResponses}}/{{maxCapacity}}).
Expand capacity at:
{{upgradeUrl}}

The Seenly Team

CAPACITY_FULL.subject: Your response capacity is full
CAPACITY_FULL.preheader: Your profile is no longer accepting new responses.
CAPACITY_FULL.title: Capacity Limit Reached
CAPACITY_FULL.body: Your Seenly profile has reached its maximum response capacity ({{maxCapacity}} responses). Upgrade your profile to continue receiving responses from friends.
CAPACITY_FULL.plainText:
Hello,

Your Seenly profile reached its maximum response limit. Upgrade to continue receiving responses:
{{upgradeUrl}}

The Seenly Team

PLUS_WELCOME.subject: Welcome to Seenly Plus!
PLUS_WELCOME.title: Plus Features Activated
PLUS_WELCOME.body: Your Seenly Plus one-time purchase has been completed successfully. Enjoy unlimited response capacity and comprehensive analytical dimensions.
PLUS_WELCOME.plainText:
Hello,

Your Seenly Plus one-time purchase has been confirmed and activated on your account.
Access your dashboard at:
{{dashboardUrl}}

The Seenly Team

PURCHASE_RECEIPT.subject: Seenly Purchase Receipt (#{{reference}})
PURCHASE_RECEIPT.title: Payment Confirmation
PURCHASE_RECEIPT.body: Your payment was processed successfully. Product: {{product}}, Amount: {{amount}} {{currency}}, Reference: {{reference}}, Date: {{timestamp}}.
PURCHASE_RECEIPT.footer: This email serves as an official transaction record.

EMAIL_CHANGED.subject: Your Seenly account email was updated
EMAIL_CHANGED.title: Email Address Changed
EMAIL_CHANGED.body: The email address associated with your Seenly account has been changed. If you did not authorize this change, please contact our support team immediately.
EMAIL_CHANGED.plainText:
Hello,

The email address associated with your Seenly account was changed. If you did not make this change, please contact us immediately:
{{securityUrl}}

The Seenly Team

ACCOUNT_DELETED.subject: Your Seenly account has been deleted
ACCOUNT_DELETED.title: Account Successfully Deleted
ACCOUNT_DELETED.body: Your Seenly account and associated profile data have been permanently deleted per your request. Thank you for using Seenly.
ACCOUNT_DELETED.plainText:
Hello,

Your Seenly account and data have been permanently removed.

The Seenly Team

LOGIN_VERIFICATION.subject: Your Seenly login verification code: {{code}}
LOGIN_VERIFICATION.preheader: Your code is valid for a short time.
LOGIN_VERIFICATION.title: Login Verification Code
LOGIN_VERIFICATION.body: Your verification code to sign in to your Seenly account is: {{code}}. This code is single-use and will expire shortly. Do not share it with anyone.
LOGIN_VERIFICATION.footer: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.
LOGIN_VERIFICATION.plainText:
Hello,

Your Seenly login verification code is: {{code}}
This code expires shortly and can only be used once. Do not share it.

The Seenly Team

REGISTRATION_VERIFICATION.body: Your verification code to register your Seenly profile is: {{code}}. This code is single-use and will expire shortly.
REGISTRATION_VERIFICATION.footer: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

The Seenly Team

EMAIL_CHANGE_VERIFICATION.subject: Your Seenly email change verification code: {{code}}

EMAIL_CHANGE_VERIFICATION.footer: If you did not initiate this change, please ignore this email.
